# Uploading and Preparing the Data

```{r}
# uploading
sites_ever_treated <- read_csv('../data/output/intersection_intervention_table_ever_treated_2015-2022.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
# meant to handle large datasets
sites_ever_treated <- as.data.table(sites_ever_treated)
```

```{r}
# scale variables
# the incidence ratio of these variables will now represent the change in odds for a *one standard deviation* increase in the original predictor
# nyc_metro_pop not included to to multicollnearity

sites_ever_treated <- sites_ever_treated %>%
  mutate(
    scaled_summonses = scale(citywide_traffic_summonses),
    scaled_traffic_volume = scale(nyc_metro_dvmt),
    scaled_pop_density = scale(pop_per_sqmi),
    scaled_time = scale(time)
  )
```

# Assigning values to TTC types

```{r}
# Assign the result back to the original data.table
sites_ever_treated_ttc <- sites_ever_treated %>%
  # Create a temporary, cleaned version of the type string for reliable searching
  mutate(
    # Replace NA with an empty string for easier processing
    # The final dummy will be 0 for these rows anyway
    ttc_type_clean = ifelse(is.na(turn_traffic_calming_type), "", turn_traffic_calming_type),
    ttc_type_clean = tolower(ttc_type_clean),
    # Fix common typos and standardize abbreviations to ensure they are captured
    ttc_type_clean = str_replace_all(ttc_type_clean, c(
      "speeed" = "speed",
      "ruber" = "rubber",
      "qucik" = "quick",
      "dayighitng" = "daylighting",
      "x-walk" = "crosswalk",
      "rsb" = "rubber speed bump",
      "hc" = "hardened centerline",
      "qk" = "quick kurb"
    ))
  ) %>%
  # Create the 11 dummy variables based on keyword detection
  mutate(
    # as.integer() converts TRUE/FALSE from str_detect() to 1/0
    ttc_hardened_centerline = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "hardened centerline")),
    
    # <<< THIS IS THE CORRECTED LINE >>>
    # It now detects "rubber speed" even if "bump" is missing.
    # The `\\b` is a word boundary to prevent matching parts of other words.
    ttc_rubber_speed_bump   = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "rubber speed bump|rubber speed\\b")),
    
    ttc_quick_kurb          = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "quick kurb|tuff kurb")),
    ttc_daylighting         = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "daylighting|dayligh")),
    # Uses a regex with a "negative lookbehind" to find "box" but not "bike box"
    # and a word boundary `\\b` to ensure it's a whole word.
    ttc_markings_box        = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "(?<!bike )\\bbox\\b")),
    ttc_markings_wedge      = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "wedge")),
    ttc_delineators         = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "delineator")),
    ttc_median_or_island    = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "median extension|bike island")),
    ttc_pegatracks          = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "pegatrack")),
    ttc_davidsons           = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "davidson")),
    ttc_slow_turn_design    = as.integer(str_detect(ttc_type_clean, "slow turn|right turn"))
  ) %>%
  # Remove the temporary cleaning column as it's no longer needed
  select(-ttc_type_clean)
```

# Validate new dummy variables

```{r}
# 1. Get the total counts for each new turn traffic calming component
ttc_cols <- colnames(sites_ever_treated_ttc)[str_starts(colnames(sites_ever_treated_ttc), "ttc_")]

# Using colSums to get the frequency of each treatment component
treatment_counts <- colSums(sites_ever_treated_ttc[, ..ttc_cols])
print("Frequency of each Turn Traffic Calming Component:")
print(treatment_counts)

# 2. Spot-check a few complex examples to ensure they were parsed correctly
print("Verification of specific complex cases:")
sites_ever_treated_ttc %>%
  filter(
    # A complex combination treatment
    str_detect(turn_traffic_calming_type, "Daylighting, Box Markings, Flexible Delineators, Quick Kurb") |
    # A treatment that should NOT be coded as a 'box'
    str_detect(turn_traffic_calming_type, "Quick Kurb to bike box")
    ) %>%
  # Select the original column and the new dummy columns to show the mapping
  select(turn_traffic_calming_type, all_of(ttc_cols)) %>%
  # Use glimpse to display in a readable format
  glimpse()
```

# More validation

```{r}
# Re-define ttc_cols in case the R environment was cleared
ttc_cols <- colnames(sites_ever_treated_ttc)[str_starts(colnames(sites_ever_treated_ttc), "ttc_")]

# Check 1: Find treatments that were applied but not categorized (False Negatives)
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- CHECK 1: Verifying all applied treatments were captured ---")

missed_treatments <- sites_ever_treated_ttc %>%
  # Filter for rows where a treatment was definitely applied
  filter(turn_traffic_calming_post == 1) %>%
  # Calculate the sum of all our new dummy variables for each row
  mutate(ttc_sum = rowSums(across(all_of(ttc_cols)))) %>%
  # Filter for rows where a treatment was applied, but our sum is zero
  filter(ttc_sum == 0)

if (nrow(missed_treatments) == 0) {
  print("SUCCESS: Every row with turn_traffic_calming_post = 1 has at least one corresponding TTC dummy variable set to 1.")
} else {
  print("WARNING: The following treatment types were missed by the keyword search. The logic may need to be updated.")
  # Show the unique `turn_traffic_calming_type` values that were missed
  print(unique(missed_treatments$turn_traffic_calming_type))
}


# Check 2: Find rows with no treatment that were incorrectly categorized (False Positives)
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- CHECK 2: Verifying no treatments were assigned to non-treated rows ---")

false_positives <- sites_ever_treated_ttc %>%
  # Filter for rows where NO treatment was applied
  filter(turn_traffic_calming_post == 0) %>%
  mutate(ttc_sum = rowSums(across(all_of(ttc_cols)))) %>%
  # Filter for rows where no treatment was applied, but our sum is greater than zero
  filter(ttc_sum > 0)

if (nrow(false_positives) == 0) {
  print("SUCCESS: Every row with turn_traffic_calming_post = 0 has all TTC dummy variables set to 0.")
} else {
  print("CRITICAL ERROR: Found rows where turn_traffic_calming_post = 0 but TTC dummies were assigned a value of 1. This should not be possible.")
  print(false_positives %>% select(intersection_id, year, turn_traffic_calming_post, all_of(ttc_cols)))
}
```

# Filter dataset to only intersections that ever got TTC

```{r}
# Identify all intersection_ids that have ever received the TTC treatment
ttc_treated_ids <- sites_ever_treated_ttc %>%
  filter(turn_traffic_calming_post == 1) %>%
  distinct(intersection_id) %>%
  pull(intersection_id)

# Filter the main dataset to keep only the intersections identified above
sites_ttc_only <- sites_ever_treated_ttc %>%
  filter(intersection_id %in% ttc_treated_ids)

# Validation and Summary
print(paste("Original number of unique intersections:", n_distinct(sites_ever_treated_ttc$intersection_id)))
print(paste("Number of unique intersections in the new TTC-only dataset:", n_distinct(sites_ttc_only$intersection_id)))
print(paste("Total rows in original dataset:", nrow(sites_ever_treated_ttc)))
print(paste("Total rows in new TTC-only dataset:", nrow(sites_ttc_only)))

# A final, robust check: confirm that every single intersection_id remaining in the new dataset did, in fact, receive a treatment at some point
validation_check <- sites_ttc_only %>%
  group_by(intersection_id) %>%
  summarise(was_treated = any(turn_traffic_calming_post == 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

if(all(validation_check$was_treated)) {
  print("SUCCESS: Validation passed. All intersections in the 'sites_ttc_only' dataset received TTC treatment in at least one year.")
} else {
  print("ERROR: Something went wrong. Not all intersections in the new dataset were treated.")
}
```
